about.heroSub: Your trusted partner for real estate in Romania since 2009

story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: RoEstate was founded in 2009 by a team of cross-border real estate professionals who recognised a growing need for transparent, multilingual property consultancy in Romania. As the country attracted increasing interest from international buyers and investors, we built a service that bridges cultures and simplifies complexity.
story.p2: Today, our team of specialist consultants serves clients from over 20 countries, helping them buy, sell, and invest across Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca, Brașov, Constanța, and beyond. We are proud to be one of the few agencies in Romania operating in English, Romanian, Turkish, and Arabic — removing language barriers so that every client feels at home.
story.p3: We believe that finding the right property should be an exciting journey, not a stressful one. That is why we provide full-service support from initial search to final signature, including legal guidance, notary coordination, and post-purchase assistance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: RoEstate SRL is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and Romanian data protection law. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights available to you.
privacy.s1Body: We may collect: your name, email address, phone number, and message content when you submit an enquiry or contact form; browsing data (IP address, browser type, pages visited) collected automatically via cookies; and any information you voluntarily provide during our consultancy process.
privacy.s2Body: We use your data to respond to enquiries and provide real estate services; to send property information you have requested; to improve our website through anonymised analytics; and to comply with legal obligations under Romanian and EU law.
privacy.s3Body: We process your data on the following grounds under GDPR Article 6: performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps at your request (Art. 6(1)(b)); our legitimate interests in operating our business (Art. 6(1)(f)); compliance with a legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)); and where required, your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a)).
privacy.s4Body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with trusted service providers acting on our behalf (CRM, email platform, web hosting) under data processing agreements. We may also disclose data to legal or regulatory authorities where required by law.
privacy.s5Body: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described here or as required by law. Enquiry and client data is typically retained for 3 years after the last interaction. You may request deletion at any time.
privacy.s6Body: Under GDPR you have the right to access, rectify, or erase your personal data; restrict or object to processing; data portability; and to withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@roestate.ro. You may also lodge a complaint with Romania's data protection authority (ANSPDCP) at www.dataprotection.ro.
privacy.s7Body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss, or destruction. All data transmitted via our website is encrypted using TLS/HTTPS.
privacy.s8Body: For privacy-related enquiries or to reach our Data Protection Officer, write to: privacy@roestate.ro — or RoEstate SRL, Str. Floreasca 14, Sector 1, București 014453, România.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how RoEstate SRL uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website. By continuing to browse, you accept our use of cookies as described below.
cookies.s1Body: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by your browser when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember information about your visit — such as your language preference — making your next visit easier and the site more useful to you.
cookies.s2Body:
Essential Cookies — required for the website to function. These include your language preference (NEXT_LOCALE, stored for 12 months) and session-state cookies. Disabling them will affect site functionality.

Analytics Cookies — we use anonymised analytics to understand how visitors use our website (pages visited, traffic sources, navigation). No personally identifiable information is collected.

Functional Cookies — these remember your preferences, such as selected property filters, to improve your browsing experience.
cookies.s3Body: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or remove cookies at any time. Note that disabling essential cookies may impair website functionality, including language switching.
cookies.s4Body: Our website embeds content from third-party providers including Google Maps. These services may set their own cookies subject to their own privacy policies. Google's privacy policy is available at policies.google.com/privacy.
cookies.s5Body: Questions about our use of cookies? Contact us at privacy@roestate.ro or write to: RoEstate SRL, Str. Floreasca 14, Sector 1, București 014453, România.
